text: Both within and outside of the effective altruism community, there is significant interest in being able to make comparisons across cause areas. Cause areas are defined as specific fields to which we could hypothetically allocate resources. Some typical examples are animal welfare, existential risk, global health and development (GHD), and climate change. This report concerns itself with the latter two. We set out to provide a rigorous framework to help inform how donors should think about donating to GHD versus climate change interventions, especially (but not limited to) those with attachments to effective altruism.
